spans.s:
लब लब, अस्, m., Ved. a quail [cf. लव];
N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda

,
(his patronymic is Aindra.)
—लब-सूक्त, अम्, n.,
N. of the hymn Ṛg-veda

लाब लाब (often written लाव), अस्, m. =
लब, a sort of quail, Perdix Chinensis; (आ), f. the
female of this bird.
—लाबाक्ष (˚ब-अक्˚) or ला-
बाक्षक, अस्, m. ‘quail-eyed,’ a kind of rice.
लब्ध लब्ध, लब्धक, &c. See col. 3.

लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, taken, seized, taken hold of,
obtained, received, got, gained, won, acquired; per-
ceived, apprehended, known, obtained (as a quotient
by division &c.; cf. लब्धि); (आ), f. a woman
whose husband or lover is faithless; epithet of a
particular heroine.
—लब्ध-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one
who has gained his wishes.
—लब्ध-कीर्त्ति, इस्, इस्,
इ, one who has won fame or glory.
—लब्ध-चेतस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, one who has recovered his right mind,
restored to sense, recovered.
—लब्ध-जन्मन्, आ,
आ, अ, one who has obtained birth, born.
—लब्ध-
दत्त, अस्, m. ‘restoring what one has received,’ a
proper N.
—लब्ध-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has acquired wealth, wealthy.
—लब्ध-नामन्, आ,
आ, अ, one who has gained a name, well spoken of,
famous, celebrated.
—लब्ध-नाश, अस्, m. the loss
of what has been acquired.
—लब्ध-प्रणाश, अस्,
m. the loss of anything acquired; N. of the fourth
book of the Pañca-tantra.
—लब्ध-प्रतिष्ठ, अस्,
आ, अम्, one who has acquired fame or renown.
—लब्ध-प्रशमन, अम्, n. the securing of
what has been acquired, keeping acquisitions in
safety; (according to Kullūka on Manu
VII. 56

)
bestowing acquisitions on a proper recipient.
—लब्-
धप्रशमन-स्वस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, at ease by
(reason of) the securing or secure possession of
acquisitions.
—लब्ध-लक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has hit the mark, one who has obtained the prize;
skilled in the use of missiles; (अस्), m. a proper N.
—लब्ध-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = लब्ध-लक्ष.
—लब्ध-वर, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained
a boon or favour; (अस्), m. a proper N.
—लब्ध-
वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has learnt his letters,
lettered, learned, sage, skilful, clever.
—लब्धवर्-
ण-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, honouring the learned.
—लब्ध-
विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has acquired knowledge
or wisdom, learned, educated.
—लब्ध-शब्द, अस्,
आ, अम्, = लब्ध-नामन्.
—लब्ध-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who has recovered his senses, restored to
consciousness.
—लब्ध-सिद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who
has attained perfection.
—लब्धानुज्ञ (˚ध-अन्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained leave of absence.
—लब्धान्तर (˚ध-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has found an opportunity.
—लब्धावकाश (˚ध-
अव्˚) or लब्धावसर (˚ध-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one
who has found an opportunity or gained scope, one
who has obtained leisure.
—लब्धोदय (˚ध-
उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has received birth or
production (Kumāra-s.

); one who has attained
prosperity, prosperous.

लब्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, obtained, received, got,
attained; [cf. दुःख-लब्धिका.]

लब्धवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has obtained or
gained or received.

लब्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained or received,
to be gained or attained, obtainable, &c. See लभ्य.

लब्धि, इस्, f. obtaining, gaining, acquisition,
acquirement, attainment; anything gained or ob-
tained, gain, advantage, profit; the quotient (in
arithmetic).

लब्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, one who obtains or
receives, a receiver, gainer, recipient.
लब्ध्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained, received, attained.

लब्ध्वा, ind. having obtained or gained, having
got.
लाबक, अस्, m. a sort of quail.
लाबु लाबु or लाबू = अ-लाबु.
लाबुकी, f. a kind of lute.

लाबुकायन लाबुकायन, अस्, m., N. of a
philosophical writer mentioned in the Jaimini-sūtras,
(probably incorrect for लामकायन.)
